title: The Assumption With the Highest Cost
short_teaser: Not all assumptions deserve equal testing.
story: Not all assumptions deserve equal testing. The most dangerous is often the one whose failure would make the whole plan collapse. Risk becomes manageable when it is ranked. Strategy means choosing what matters most and placing effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Risk becomes manageable when it is ranked. Strategy means choosing what matters most and placing effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
